sub_sector.value: Commercial lithium-ion batteries; battery energy storage systems

manufacturing_type.detail: Produces cathode, anode and electrolyte, manufactures lithium-ion cells, and assembles modules, packs and energy storage systems.

product_complexity.detail: Tailors cell chemistry to customer applications requiring high energy density, fast charging, long cycle life and built-in safety.

production_role.detail: Supplies application-specific battery packs for transportation and heavy equipment and manufactures finished energy storage systems.

end_market_exposure.detail: Serves transportation and heavy equipment electrification and supplies energy storage systems.

notes: Microvast describes customer-specific designs, but the evidence leaves production timing relative to orders unclear.
